message:
So `mrb_assert` is a no-op unless `MRB_DEBUG` is defined. The fuzzer build likely doesn't define `MRB_DEBUG`, so the assert won't fire.

Now let me check the `new_litbn` function in codegen.c to understand how the pool string is constructed:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>sed -n '1004,1060p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/mrbgems/mruby-compiler/core/codegen.c</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
